Name: (AT) Akuma's Spouse Portraits
Author: sdboyakuma
Description:
Content Patcher version [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22530](CP) Akuma's Seasonal Spouse Portraits[/url]

adds four new textures to spouse portraits. 
based and inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] and  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21388](AT) Ornate Spouse Portraits[/url].  Added textures for all the spouse's seasonal outfits with darker frames

Mod Requirements:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures
[/url]
Optional File:
Adds four festival portraits for each marriage candidate (can be used with main file)

ATTENTION!!

this mod does not change the portraits each season, you have to use the paint bucket from alternative textures.
this mod just has different outfits for the spouse portraits. 
I am currently working on a seasonally changing version which should be released soon!

This is my first mod, please let me know if anyone has any suggestions for improvement!

Downloads.Description:
adds new textures for spouse portraits for each season

four different frames for each seasonal portrait
Installation:

download and unzip into mod folder
